description: Resource schema for AWS::WellArchitected::AgentProfilePolicy. Attaches an IAM resource-based policy to an Agent Profile controlling cross-account access to the profile and its child resources (recommendations, goals, contexts). One policy per profile: the parent profile's ARN is the primary identifier. Standard CloudFormation policy-attachment pattern (see AWS::S3::BucketPolicy).

ProfileArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the parent Agent Profile the policy is attached to. Pass `!GetAtt` (or `!Ref`) of the parent AWS::WellArchitected::AgentProfile to flow its ARN here. Also serves as the primary identifier of this policy attachment.

Policy.description: The IAM resource-based policy document as a JSON string. Allow-only statements, no negation condition operators, maximum 51200 characters.
